students and instructors identified the following as important for effective online learning: 1) the importance of course content, 2) the importance of instructor presence and interaction, 3) the importance of a community of learners, 4) the importance of student engagement, and 5) the importance of the use of technology.

the most effective online learning experiences are those that provide students with opportunities to connect course content to their real world experiences, and that provide opportunities to interact with peers and instructors in a meaningful way.

the research found a lack of student and instructor interaction in online learning environments and that students and instructors are looking for more opportunities for student to student and instructor to student interaction.

the most effective online learning environments are those in which students are able to interact with course content, with their instructor, and with other students.

online learning experiences can be positive when the course is designed with a strong focus on student learning, and when students are actively engaged in the process of constructing meaning and understanding.

the online learning environment is a unique learning environment that has the potential to offer unique learning experiences that are not always possible in traditional face-to-face classrooms.

the online learning experience can be a positive one, but it requires careful planning, attention to the needs of the students, and a willingness to experiment with new approaches.
